plot: Jin Taekyung receives the Myriad-Poison Ring, but Item Appraisal fails because a special condition is required. The Divine Physician estimates that the ring raises Jeok Cheongang's treatment prospects above seventy percent and agrees to make up the remainder with his medical skill. Tang Sadok selects the secluded, sunless, freezing underground prison of the Sichuan Tang Clan as the treatment site and leads the party toward its deepest and largest cell.

While the party prepares for treatment, Cheongpung befriends Mimi-chan, who performs the Whirlwind technique at his command. In a separate scene, an unidentified middle-aged man kills four Tang Clan men, interrogates a survivor, and claims that Poison King Tang Taesang endured four days of torture before dying.

profile_creations.personality: Cheerfully sadistic and grotesquely jovial, treating torture and mutilation as enjoyable work.

profile_creations.voice: Obsequious and folksy, with a deferential tone toward Tang Sadok and a gleefully macabre undertone.
